no_adcom_quote.quote: No Advisory Committee meeting was held to discuss this application.

summary: No Advisory Committee meeting was convened for the PREPOPIK (NDA202535) approval. The review documents (SumR, CrossR, ODMemo, MedR) consistently state the application was not referred to an AC because the drug was not first-in-class, had a safety profile and study design similar to previously approved products in the class, raised no significant safety/efficacy or public health questions, and did not require outside expertise. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to any changes in the approval.
